output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_invoice_payments
FROM marts.fct_payments p
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE p.method = 'invoice'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND (p.paid_at - o.order_date) > 30
output.explanation: Joins payments to their orders, keeps invoice payments on orders placed in 2025, and counts payments where paid_at is more than 30 days after order_date. Date subtraction in PostgreSQL returns whole days. The count is of payments, not distinct orders. No status filter is added because fct_payments only holds payments for completed and returned orders.
